role_in_parent: This is the sharp global upper bound at the discrete endpoints a/n; it is the main frontier/bottleneck step.
statement_nl: For every integer n>1 and every integer a with 0 <= a <= n-1, one has E_n(a/n) <= H_n - 1, and equality holds if and only if a = n-1.

domain_restrictions: a divided by n is in the rational numbers (input to E_n), and lies in the interval from 0 to 1 inclusive of 0 and exclusive of 1 when a < n
statement_semantic_sketch.normalized_claim: For every integer n with n > 1 and every integer a with 0 <= a <= n - 1, the real value E_n evaluated at (a divided by n) satisfies E_n(a/n) <= H_n minus 1; moreover, E_n(a/n) equals H_n minus 1 if and only if a equals n - 1.

variables.name: n
variables.role: common parameter indexing the quantities E_n and H_n

variables.name: a
variables.role: index controlling the input a/n to E_n

witness_dependencies: no existential witnesses are introduced; the equality condition is a universal conditional about the given a
